_about: What each council's own website tells private landlords about the landlord database (Register your rental property), read on the date in 'checked'. status: deadline = mentions it and gives the 15 Dec 2026 opening or the region's deadline; mentions = mentions it without dates; act only = Renters' Rights Act but not the database; nothing = landlord pages found, neither; unreachable = could not read. Quotes checked word for word against the live page on that date (where a site blocks automated readers entirely, the council's 'note' says where the quote was read) ('...' joins parts of one sentence). Research: co-founder/research/{west-midlands,east-of-england,east-midlands,south-east}-council-notices-2026-11-07.md and {yorkshire,north-east}-council-notices-2026-11-08.md.
